title: Negative threshold applies the Winkler bonus instead of giving plain Jaro
property: with a negative threshold, similarity equals the plain Jaro similarity (no Winkler bonus)
actual: 0.7 (Winkler bonus applied, since j > threshold is always true)
evidence: Constructor javadoc: 'Set threshold to a negative value to get the Jaro distance.' The code adds the bonus when j > threshold, so a negative threshold always adds it; Jaro needs threshold >= 1.
